blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Advances in generative models have substantially improved the fidelity of video generation, propelling the field toward long-horizon generation, interactive world modeling, and evolving visual environments.
Autoregressive (AR) video generation offers a natural paradigm for these tasks by sequentially extending visual sequences through a causal step-wise rollout. However, a fundamental bottleneck emerges: as the generated sequence expands, practical models must operate under strictly bounded context windows, storage, and computational limits. Consequently, critical historical information, e.g. , entity identities, spatial layouts, dynamic states, and intervention-induced causal changes, often leaves the active context long before its relevance diminishes. Overcoming this limitation and maintaining temporal persistence constitutes a fundamental memory problem.
This survey presents a systematic and comprehensive review of memory mechanisms in AR video generation. We formulate memory operationally as persistent historical information maintained across outer AR steps, capable of influencing future generation even after the originating evidence is no longer locally accessible. Building upon this unified framework, we organize the literature through five complementary perspectives: (I) Forms , the representational carriers of history; (II) Functions , the specific semantic and physical information requiring preservation; (III) Operations , the lifecycle of writing, reading, updating, managing, and integrating memory; (IV) Learning , the optimization of memory behaviors under closed-loop rollouts; and (V) Evaluation , the paradigms for diagnosing genuine memory capabilities.
Through these perspectives, we emphasize a core insight: effective memory transcends mere capacity. Retained states must remain accurate, accessible, and causally influential to subsequent generation. We conclude by synthesizing open challenges, including composable and resource-aware memory architectures, trustworthy state updating, self-rollout learning, and standardized evaluation. By bridging representations, mechanisms, and learning paradigms, this survey establishes a structured foundation for developing reliable, memory-conditioned video generation systems. = Date : September 2026 = Contact : {haroldchen328, guorong3529, disenlan1002, wenjieshu2003, fayehongfeizhang}@gmail.com Repository : https://github.com/HaroldChen19/Awesome-AR-Video-Memory

自动递归(AR)视频生成为这些任务提供了自然的范式,通过因果的阶梯式推出,相继扩展视觉序列. 然而,一个根本的瓶颈出现:随着生成的序列的扩展,实用模型必须在严格限定的上下文窗口,存储,和计算限制下运行. 因此,关键的历史信息,如实体身份、空间布局、动态状态和干预引起的因果变化,往往在相关性减弱之前很久就离开了积极背景。 克服这一限制并保持时间持久性是一个根本的记忆问题。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid evolution of generative modeling, driven by scalable Transformer-based architectures, particularly diffusion transformers [ vaswani2017attention , peebles2023scalable ] , has enabled substantial progress in high-fidelity image and short-video generation [ esser2024scaling , labs2025flux , cai2025z , wan2025wan , hacohen2026ltx ] . The field is now advancing toward longer-horizon visual generation, including open-ended video generation [ yang2025longlive , huang2026self ] and interactive video world modeling [ team2026advancing , mao2025yume ] , where models must continuously extend visual sequences while preserving entities, layouts, motions, events, and long-range temporal commitments. A natural paradigm for this objective is autoregressive (AR) video generation , which sequentially predicts future tokens, frames, or chunks conditioned on previously generated or observed visual units. Evolving from early discrete-token frameworks ( e.g. , VideoGPT [ yan2021videogpt ] ) and inference-time AR adaptations ( e.g. , FreeNoise [ qiu2024freenoise ] ), to recent AR diffusion frameworks ( e.g. , Causal Forcing [ zhu2026causal ] ), AR generation provides a scalable interface for streaming, continuation, and controllable long-form generation.
blocks.zh: 由可伸缩变形器基架构驱动的基因模型的快速演化,特别是扩散变形器[vaswani 2017atenty, pilebles 2023s 可伸缩],使得高真影像和短视生成[esser 2024scaling],实验室2025flux,cai2025z,wan2025wan,hacohen2026ltx]有了实质性的进步. 包括无限视频生成[yang2025 longlive, huang2026self], 以及互动视频世界建模[team2026apriling, mao2025yume], 模型必须不断扩展视觉序列, 这个目标的自然范式是自动递归(AR)视频生成,它依次预测以先前生成或观测到的视觉单元为条件的未来符号、帧或块。 从早期的离散键框架(例如,VideoGPT [yan2021videogpt])和推论时间AR适应(例如,FreeNoise [qiu2024freenoise])演变为最近的AR扩散框架(例如,Causal Forcing [zhu2026causal]),AR生成为流化,延续,以及可控制的长形式生成提供了可伸缩的接口.

blocks.en: Despite this scalability, extending AR generation to long horizons raises a central challenge: maintaining temporal persistence under bounded access to history . High-fidelity local generation alone is insufficient, since information required at a later step may no longer be available in the immediate context. Long-term consistency therefore depends on retention : the ability to selectively preserve, update, retrieve, and integrate historical information according to its future relevance. Without effective retention, recursive generation may progressively forget or distort previously established entities, appearances, spatial layouts, motion states, or events [ huang2026self , zhu2026causal , yang2025longlive ] . Existing strategies range from rolling visual windows and KV-cache retention [ kim2024fifo , yin2025slow , qiu2024freenoise ] to more structured designs based on 3D priors [ wang2026latent ] , compressed latent states [ zhang2025tinyhistory ] , and retrieval banks [ hu2026longlive ] . Although developed under different terminologies and architectural assumptions, these techniques address a shared functional problem: preserving and exposing useful historical information to subsequent generation . In this survey, we study them through the unifying lens of memory mechanisms .
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这种可扩展性,将AR生成扩展到长视野,但提出了中心挑战:在有限度地接触历史的情况下保持时间持久性。 仅靠当地高可靠性的一代是不够的,因为今后阶段所需的信息可能不再在眼前提供。 因此,长期一致性取决于保留:能够根据其未来的相关性有选择地保存、更新、检索和综合历史信息。 如果没有有效的保留,递归生成可能会逐渐忘记或扭曲先前建立的实体,外观,空间布局,运动状态,或事件[huang2026self, zhu2026causal, yang2025 longlife]. 现有的策略从滚动视觉窗口和KV-cache保留[kim2024fifo,yin2025slow ,qiu2024freenoise]到基于3D前传[wang2026latent],压缩潜伏状态[zhang2025tinyhtory],以及检索库[hu2026longlive]的更有条理的设计. 尽管这些技术是在不同的术语和建筑假设下开发的,但这些技术解决了一个共同的功能问题:保存有用的历史信息并将其暴露给下一代。 在本次调查中,我们通过记忆机制的统一视角来研究它们。

blocks.en: ➤ Memory Definition. Memory is a persistent representation of past observations, generated states, or established world states and semantic commitments that is maintained across autoregressive steps and systematically conditions subsequent generation. Operationally, a state functions as memory when its removal or modification can affect later outputs after the corresponding evidence is no longer directly available in the immediate context.
blocks.zh: QQ 记忆定义. 记忆是过去观察、产生的国家或既定的世界状态和语义承诺的不断体现,这些都贯穿于自旋步骤和后代的系统性条件。 在操作上,当消除或修改状态会影响相应证据不再直接可用后产生的产出时,状态作为内存发挥作用。

blocks.en: This definition does not draw a rigid boundary between memory and long context. Recent tokens, frames, or chunks that are densely consumed at every step constitute the active local context. As historical information is selectively retained, compressed, retrieved, consolidated, or revised beyond this local window, it moves from active context toward persistent memory. The distinction therefore depends on how historical information is maintained and used, rather than on a particular carrier, module name, or context-window size.
blocks.zh: 这个定义并没有在内存和长上下文之间划出僵硬的界限. 近期的标志、框或块在每一个步骤上都大量消耗,构成了积极的当地背景。 由于历史信息被有选择地保留,压缩,检索,合并,或修改到这个本地窗口之外,它从积极上下文走向持续的内存. 因此,这种区别取决于历史信息的保存和使用方式,而不是取决于某一特定载体、模块名称或上下文窗口大小。

blocks.en: Despite growing attention, memory in AR video generation remains insufficiently systematized in two respects. (I) Lack of a Paradigm-Specific Taxonomy: Existing surveys on video diffusion [ xing2024survey , melnik2024video , li2024survey ] and world models [ zhu2024sora , ding2025understanding , liu2026towards ] cover broader generative paradigms but do not treat memory as a central design problem of causal AR rollouts, where memory is often discussed narrowly in terms of retrieval or long-context conditioning. (II) Fragmented Conceptual Standards: Recent studies use the term “memory” for mechanisms that differ substantially in their objectives, assumptions, representations, and deployment settings, while functionally related mechanisms may instead be described as context, cache, history, or state. This fragmentation obscures shared design principles and trade-offs, making systematic comparison difficult.
blocks.zh: 尽管人们日益关注,AR视频生成中的记忆在两个方面仍然不够系统化. (一)缺乏一个范式-特定分类学:关于视频传播的现有调查[xing2024 survey , melnik2024video, li2024 survey]和世界模型[zhu2024sora, ding2025 understanding, liu2026towards]涵盖更广泛的基因范式,但不将记忆视为因果AR推出的中央设计问题,因为记忆往往在检索或长文本调节方面被狭义地讨论. (二) 不成体系的概念标准: 最近的研究对目标、假设、表述和部署设置大不相同的机制使用“记忆”一词,而功能相关的机制则可以被描述为上下文、缓存、历史或状态。 这种分散模糊了共同的设计原则和权衡,使系统比较变得困难。

blocks.en: To bridge these gaps, this paper presents a comprehensive survey and unified framework for memory mechanisms in autoregressive video generation. We first establish the problem setting and formalize the role of memory under bounded access to history in Section § 2 . Building on this foundation, we organize the literature along five core questions:
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,本文为自动视频生成中的内存机制提出了全面的调查和统一框架. 我们首先确定问题设置,并在第2节中正式规定在对历史的有限访问下记忆的作用。 在这个基础上,我们按照五个核心问题组织文献:

blocks.en: To answer these questions, the remainder of this survey systematically deconstructs the memory pipeline. Section § 3 addresses question ❶ by categorizing the carriers of historical information into visual, implicit, explicit, and parametric forms. Section § addresses question ❷ by organizing the historical properties that memory must preserve into identity, spatial, dynamic, semantic, and causal responsibilities. Section § then describes the operational lifecycle through which historical evidence is written, read, updated, managed, and integrated during sequential rollout (question ❸).
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,本次调查的其余部分系统地解析了内存管道. 第3节通过将历史信息的载体分为视觉、隐含、明示和参数形式来处理问题。 第§节通过将记忆必须保存的历史属性组织为身份、空间、动态、语义和因果责任来解决问题。 第§节随后描述了在连续推出过程中编写、阅读、更新、管理和整合历史证据的运行周期(问题)。

blocks.en:
Moving from architecture to optimization, Section § for question ❹ reviews how memory is learned through training objectives, memory-state distributions, and memory-aware optimization strategies.
For question ❺, Section § examines existing evaluation practices, with particular attention to the distinction between memory-revealing protocols and general measures of video quality or temporal consistency.
Finally, Section § synthesizes these structural and empirical insights to identify unresolved challenges and future directions for memory-conditioned AR video generation.
Together, these perspectives span three levels: system characterization (Forms, Functions, and Operations), system construction (Learning), and evidential validation (Evaluation).
blocks.zh:
从架构到优化, §节用于回答QQ问题, 审查如何通过训练目标, 内存状态分布以及内存意识优化策略来学习内存.
关于QQ问题,§节审查了现有的评价做法,特别注意内存-揭示协议与视频质量或时间一致性的一般衡量标准之间的区别。
最后,§节综合了这些结构和经验上的见解,以找出尚未解决的挑战和未来方向,用于内存条件的AR视频生成.
这些视角共同跨越三个层面:系统特征(形式、功能和业务)、系统构建(学习)和证据验证(评价)。

blocks.en: In summary, the primary contributions of this survey are fourfold: ( i ) we provide a unified formulation of memory in autoregressive video generation, clarifying its role in sustaining temporal persistence across long-horizon rollouts; ( ii ) we develop a structured taxonomy that characterizes memory mechanisms by their representational carriers (Forms), generative responsibilities (Functions), and operational lifecycles (Operations); ( iii ) we systematically review how memory is learned and evaluated, covering training objectives, memory-state distributions, memory-aware optimization, and the distinction between general video consistency and memory-revealing evidence; and ( iv ) we synthesize existing progress and shared trade-offs to identify key challenges and future directions for memory-conditioned video generation.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,本调查的主要贡献有四方面:(一) 我们提供自递录视频生成中内存的统一表达方式,澄清其在保持长期持续性方面的作用;(二) 我们开发一种结构化的分类学,通过它们的代表载体(形式)、基因责任(功能)和业务生命周期(业务)来描述内存机制;(三) 我们系统地审查内存的学习和评价方式,包括培训目标、内存状态分布、内存意识优化,以及一般内存一致性和内存恢复性证据之间的区别;(四) 我们综合现有的进展和共同权衡,以确定内存条件内存视频生成的关键挑战和未来方向。

blocks.en: This survey focuses on memory mechanisms for autoregressive video generation, where visual units, e.g. , tokens, frames, or chunks, are causally generated from previously observed or generated history. We cover both discrete-token and continuous AR generators, including diffusion-, flow-, and Transformer-based formulations, when they explicitly preserve, manage, or transform historical state to condition subsequent visual generation. This includes long-horizon and interactive world generation under causal visual rollout, while excluding short-video generation without persistent cross-step memory. Closely related world-action models (WAMs) are covered selectively: recent systems increasingly adopt AR video-action modeling, yet their primary objective is typically action or policy prediction, with memory often realized implicitly through persistent KV states rather than treated as a dedicated design problem ( e.g. , LingBot-VA [ li2026causal ] ). We therefore discuss such models only when their memory mechanisms directly inform AR visual generation, rather than attempting comprehensive coverage of the WAM literature.
blocks.zh: 本次调查侧重于自递录视频生成的内存机制,其中视觉单元,例如信使,帧,或块,都是由以前观察到或生成的历史因果产生的. 我们涵盖离散式和连续式AR发电机,包括扩散式、流式和变形器式配体,当它们明确保存、管理或改变历史状态,以附带随后的视觉生成条件时。 这包括在因果视觉推广下长视距和交互世界代,同时排除短视代,没有持续的跨步记忆. 有选择地涵盖密切相关的世界行动模型:最近的系统越来越多地采用AR视频行动模型,但其主要目标通常是行动或政策预测,记忆往往通过持续的KV状态间接实现,而不是作为一个专门的设计问题(例如,LingBot-VA[li2026causal])。 因此,我们只有在这些模型的记忆机制直接为AR视觉生成提供信息时,而不是试图全面报道WAM文献时,才讨论这些模型。

blocks.en: 2 Background: Why is Memory Needed?
blocks.zh: 2个 背景情况: 为什么需要记忆?

blocks.en: Memory in autoregressive (AR) video generation is realized through diverse mechanisms, ranging from retained visual context and neural states to retrieval stores and structured world representations. To establish a unified foundation, we first formulate AR video generation as a causal rollout over generic visual units, including tokens, frames, latents, clips, and chunks, and distinguish the principal paradigms used to generate each unit. By separating the outer temporal rollout from the inner generation process, this formulation covers discrete predictors as well as diffusion- and flow-based generators under a common notation. We next examine bounded historical access in practical AR systems and clarify the relationship between active local context and persistent memory. Finally, we introduce a memory-conditioned formulation and use it to characterize the failure modes caused by limited access to history, providing the formal basis for the representational forms, functional responsibilities, operations, learning strategies, and evaluation practices discussed in subsequent sections.
blocks.zh: 自动递归(AR)视频生成中的记忆通过多种机制实现,从保留视觉上下文和神经状态到检索商店和结构化的世界表现. 为了建立统一的基础,我们首先制定AR视频生成法,作为通用视觉单元的因果推广,包括符号、帧、潜伏、剪辑和块,并区分用于生成每个单元的主要范式。 通过将外部时间推展与内部生成过程区分开来,这种配方涵盖离散预测器以及在通用标记下以扩散和流动为基础的发电机。 我们接下来审查实际AR系统中的有限历史访问,并澄清积极的地方背景与持续记忆之间的关系。 最后,我们采用了一种具有内存条件的提法,并用它来描述因获取历史的机会有限而造成的失败模式,为下文各节所讨论的代表形式、职能责任、业务、学习战略和评价做法提供了正式的基础。

blocks.zh: 2.1 自动视频生成

Nevertheless, each generated unit still becomes part of the conditioning history for subsequent steps. The two paradigms therefore differ in their inner synthesis processes but face the same long-horizon requirement: preserving useful historical information as direct access to the expanding history becomes bounded.

blocks.en: 2.3 Bounded Historical Access
blocks.zh: 2.3 边界历史通道

blocks.en:
The AR factorization provides a scalable way to extend generation in time, but it does not by itself guarantee long-term consistency. In principle, the conditioning history 𝐲 < n \mathbf{y}_{<n} grows monotonically with the rollout. In practice, standard self-attention incurs quadratic sequence-length complexity. Sparse-attention architectures [ child2019generating ] and IO-aware kernels such as FlashAttention [ dao2022flashattention ] substantially improve practical efficiency, but continually growing visual histories remain constrained by accelerator memory, KV-cache storage, and latency.
Practical step-wise generators therefore typically operate on a bounded local context: 𝐂 n = 𝐲 max ⁡ ( 1 , n − W ) : n − 1 , \mathbf{C}_{n}=\mathbf{y}_{\max(1,n-W):n-1}, (4) where W W denotes the maximum number of recent visual units retained in the active context. The full-history conditional distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐲 n ∣ 𝐲 < n , 𝐜 ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{y}_{n}\mid\mathbf{y}_{<n},\mathbf{c}) is consequently approximated by p θ ​ ( 𝐲 n ∣ 𝐂 n , 𝐜 ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{y}_{n}\mid\mathbf{C}_{n},\mathbf{c}) .

blocks.en: For open-ended long video generation, bounded context controls computation and supports local continuity, but removes direct access to evidence outside the active window [ dai2019transformer ] . Information about earlier entities, scene layouts, motion states, or visual anchors must then be propagated through recent generations, preserved in a separate historical state, or become unavailable to the generator. This loss of access compounds other sources of long-horizon degradation, including autoregressive error accumulation, stochastic variation across generated chunks, and the mismatch between teacher-forced training and self-rolled-out inference. Reconciling expanding temporal dependencies with bounded computation is therefore a central requirement for long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh: 对于开放式的长视频生成,边框控制上下文计算并支持局部连续性,但移除了在活动窗口外直接获取证据[dai2019 transfer]. 然后,关于早期实体、场景布局、运动状态或视觉锚地的信息必须传播到近代人,保存在不同的历史状态中,或成为生成者无法获取的信息。 这种接触的丧失使长期退化的其他来源更为复杂,包括自转性误差累积、不同生成块之间的结构变化、以及教师培训和自我推论之间的不匹配。 因此,将不断扩大的时间依赖性与有限度的计算相协调,是长距离生成的核心要求。

blocks.en: The same constraint becomes more pronounced in action-conditioned or interactive video generation, e.g. , Genie [ bruce2024genie ] , where future observations depend not only on previous visual units but also on past interventions. Let 𝐚 n \mathbf{a}_{n} denote the control action applied before step n n . The causal rollout can be written as: p θ ( 𝐲 1 : N ∣ 𝐜 , 𝐚 1 : N ) = ∏ n = 1 N p θ ( 𝐲 n ∣ 𝐲 < n , 𝐚 ≤ n , 𝐜 ) . p_{\theta}(\mathbf{y}_{1:N}\mid\mathbf{c},\mathbf{a}_{1:N})=\prod_{n=1}^{N}p_{\theta}(\mathbf{y}_{n}\mid\mathbf{y}_{<n},\mathbf{a}_{\leq n},\mathbf{c}). (5) We distinguish observation-changing controls , such as camera or agent-navigation commands in an otherwise static environment, from state-changing interventions that modify entities, relations, or the environment itself. Both introduce long-range dependencies, but the former primarily stresses spatial preservation, whereas causal preservation concerns the persistent consequences of the latter. For state-changing interventions, world evolution may depend on actions that occurred far outside the active window. If only recent observations and actions remain accessible, an earlier intervention, such as moving an object or opening a door, may no longer constrain the output when its consequence must later be reflected [ wang2026matrix , nam2026worldcam , mao2025yume ] . This is a causal instance of bounded historical access: the generator must preserve action-induced state changes after the originating evidence has left the local context.

(5) 我们区分了改变观测控制,例如在否则静止环境中的照相机或代理导航指令,以及改变实体、关系或环境本身的状态变化干预。 两者都提出了长期依赖性,但前者主要强调空间保护,而因果保全则涉及后者的持续后果。 就改变状态的干预而言,世界演变可能取决于在积极窗口之外发生的行动。 如果只有最近的观测结果和行动仍然可以获取,那么在以后必须反映结果时,早先的干预,如移动物体或打开一个门,可能不再会限制输出[wang2026matrix,nam2026worldcam,mao2025yume]. 这是有限度的历史访问的因果实例:在原始证据离开当地背景后,生成者必须保留由行动引起的状态变化。

blocks.en: Long context and memory are not separated by a fixed window length. Recent tokens, frames, or KV states that are supplied directly to every generation step constitute the active context; enlarging this context increases the amount of history immediately available to the generator. Historical conditioning serves a memory role when information is persistently maintained and its access is explicitly managed through operations such as selection, compression, indexing, retrieval, consolidation, or revision. In this survey, the distinction between 𝐂 n \mathbf{C}_{n} and the memory state introduced next is therefore operational: 𝐂 n \mathbf{C}_{n} denotes the recent history directly consumed by the step-wise generator, whereas memory denotes managed historical state maintained across AR steps. Practical systems may combine both forms of conditioning.
blocks.zh: 长上下文和内存不是用固定窗口长度分隔的. 直接提供给每一代步骤的最近符号、帧或 KV 表示构成活性上下文; 扩展此上下文会增加生成器可立即使用的历史 。 当信息得到持续维护并通过选择、压缩、索引、检索、合并或修订等操作明确管理其访问时,历史条件就起到内存的作用。 在此次调查中, Cn\ mathbf{C}_{n} 与接下来引入的内存状态的区别因此可以操作: Cn \ mathbf{C}_{n} 表示由阶梯生成器直接消耗的近代历史, 而内存则表示整个 AR 步骤保持的管理历史状态 。 实用的系统可以结合两种形式的调节.

blocks.en: Both open-ended and interactive generation settings thus expose the same structural tension: historical dependencies can grow indefinitely, whereas generation operates under finite capacity. This motivates memory-conditioned AR generation [ zhu2025memorize , king2026echo , wu2026infinite ] , in which a persistent and tractable historical state complements the bounded active context.
blocks.zh: 因此,不限成员名额和互动的一代环境都暴露了同样的结构紧张:历史依赖性可以无限增长,而一代在有限能力下运作。 这激发了有记忆条件的AR生成[zhu2025 memorize , King2026echo , wu2026infinite],其中持续和可拉动的历史状态补充了受约束的活性上下文.

blocks.en: The scope of memory is determined by persistent temporal transfer rather than by module naming or carrier type. A state functions as memory when it is maintained across AR steps to preserve historical information that is not guaranteed to remain available in the active context and systematically influences subsequent generation. Static conditions, such as an initial text prompt, are not memory by themselves unless the system derives and maintains evolving states, interactions, or action-induced changes from them during rollout.

blocks.en: 2.5 Failure Modes of Memoryless Rollouts
blocks.zh: 2.5 无记忆推出失败模式

blocks.en: The memory-conditioned formulation treats 𝐌 n \mathbf{M}_{n} as a managed state for historical information that is not guaranteed to remain accessible through 𝐂 n \mathbf{C}_{n} . We use memoryless rollout to refer operationally to generation in which such persistent state is absent or severely constrained, leaving the model to rely primarily on the finite-context distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐲 n ∣ 𝐂 n , 𝐜 ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{y}_{n}\mid\mathbf{C}_{n},\mathbf{c}) . This does not imply an absence of all history, since 𝐂 n \mathbf{C}_{n} still provides recent visual units. Such bounded conditioning can preserve local continuity but offers limited support for long-range visual, semantic, and causal coherence, leading to several recurring failure modes.
blocks.zh: 内存条件化的配方将M n\ mathbf{M}_{n}作为无法通过C n\mathbf{C}_{n}保证能够持续访问的历史信息的管理状态. 我们使用无记忆的推出来在操作上指代这种持久性状态不存在或受到严重限制的一代,让模型主要依赖限定文本分布 p \\\ (y n \ c n, c) p \\ theta} (\ mathb{ y\\\ n mathb{ c\ n},\ mathb{ c}) 。 这并不意味着没有全部历史,因为 C n\ mathbf{C}_{n} 仍然提供最近的视觉单元 。 这种限定条件可以保持局部连续性,但对远距离视觉、语义和因果一致性提供有限的支持,导致若干反复出现的故障模式。

blocks.en: Once an object or character leaves the active context, the evidence needed to identify it may no longer condition generation. Upon reappearance, the entity may be omitted, duplicated, assigned different attributes, or replaced by a visually similar but distinct instance [ he2026entitybench , zhang2026mbench ] . In human-centric generation, this often appears as drift in facial identity, body shape, or other instance-defining details.
blocks.zh: 一旦一个物体或字符离开活性上下文,识别它所需的证据就可能不再附带生成条件. 重新出现时,该实体可能被省略、复制、指定不同的属性,或被视觉上类似但截然不同的实例[h2026entity bench., zhang2026mbench]所取代。 在以人类为中心的一代中,这常常作为漂移在面部特征,身体形状,或者其他实例定义细节中出现.

blocks.en: Even when an entity remains visible, its appearance may progressively deviate through unintended changes in texture, color, lighting, or style [ team2025inferix , huang2024vbench ] . Since each step conditions primarily on recent generated outputs, small visual errors can be repeatedly propagated and amplified in the absence of a stable long-range reference.
blocks.zh: 即使一个实体仍然可见,其外观也可能因纹理、颜色、照明或风格[group2025inferix ,huang2024vbench]的意外变化而逐渐偏离。 由于每个步骤条件主要针对最近产生的产出,在缺乏稳定的远程参考的情况下,小的视觉错误可以反复传播和放大.

blocks.en: Without persistent spatial state, the generator has no direct record of global scene structure after the supporting observations leave the active context. When a previously observed region re-enters the field of view, the model may produce incompatible layouts, background geometry, or object placements [ xu2026worldroambench , ye2026mind ] . These failures reflect weak preservation of spatial topology across temporally separated observations.
blocks.zh: 没有持续的空间状态,在辅助观测离开活性上下文后,生成器没有全球场景结构的直接记录. 当一个先前观测到的区域重新进入视野时,模型可能会产生不兼容的布局,背景几何,或者物体布置[xu2026worldroambench,ye2026mind]. 这些失败反映了空间地形在时间上分开的观测中保存不力。

blocks.en: Limited historical access also weakens the preservation of evolving motion states [ bansal2025videophy , jain2026mechverse ] . Although individual transitions may remain locally plausible, extended rollouts can exhibit unnatural kinematics, motion freezing, phase inconsistency, or physical contact violations. These failures become more pronounced when early motion errors are repeatedly fed back through the active context and alter subsequent dynamics.
blocks.zh: 有限的历史接触也削弱了对不断发展的运动状态的保存[bansal2025videophy , jain2026mechverse]. 虽然个别的过渡在当地可能仍然合理,但扩展后可能出现非自然动静、运动冻结、阶段不一致或身体接触违规。 当早期运动错误通过活性上下文反复反馈并改变之后的动态时,这些失败变得更加明显.

blocks.en: Long-form generation must preserve semantic commitments established during the rollout, including events, roles, relations, and unresolved goals. Even when the initial prompt remains available, these commitments may leave the active context, causing memoryless rollouts to contradict or repeat prior events, lose narrative progression, or fail to complete extended actions [ tang2025seqbench , wang2025your ] . The video may therefore remain locally plausible while diverging from its global semantic intent.
blocks.zh: 长形式一代必须保留在推出过程中确立的语义承诺,包括事件、作用、关系和未实现的目标。 即使最初的提示仍然可用,这些承诺也可能留下积极的背景,导致无记忆的展开与先前的事件相矛盾或重复,失去叙事进展,或者无法完成扩展的行动[tang2025seqbench., wang2025your]. 因此,该录像可能仍然具有当地的合理性,但不同于其全球语义意图。

blocks.en: For state-changing interventions, the resulting world state should persist after the action leaves the active context. Otherwise, an opened door may revert to closed, a displaced object may return to its original position, or an altered environment may reset [ duan2026liveworld , ma2026out ] . Such failures occur when interventions are treated as transient controls rather than as updates to a persistent state whose consequences constrain later generation.
blocks.zh: 就改变国家的干预措施而言,在行动离开积极背景后,所产生的世界国家应继续存在。 否则,一个打开的大门可能恢复到封闭状态,一个被移动的物体可能回到原来的位置,或者一个被改变的环境可能重新设置[duan2026liveworld, ma2026out]. 如果干预被视为暂时控制,而不是更新影响后一代人的持续状态,就会出现这种失败。

Collectively, these failure modes show that the central challenge in long-horizon AR generation is not temporal length alone, but temporal persistence under bounded historical access. Addressing this challenge requires mechanisms that retain entity identity, anchor appearance, preserve spatial topology, track evolving dynamics, maintain semantic commitments, and record causal state transitions. The following sections examine these mechanisms through their representational forms, functional responsibilities, operational policies, learning paradigms, and evaluation practices.

blocks.en: 3 Forms: What Carries Memory?
blocks.zh: 3 表单 : 什么卡莉记忆?

blocks.en: Before examining what memory should preserve to address the failure modes identified in Section § 2.5 , we first ask a structural question: what computational objects carry historical information across AR steps? This motivates a carrier-centric taxonomy of memory mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 在研究应该保存哪些内存以解决第2.5节中确定的故障模式之前,我们首先提出一个结构性问题:哪些计算对象将历史信息贯穿AR步骤? 这激发了以载体为中心的记忆机制分类.

blocks.en: We use memory carrier to denote the representational object in which historical information is retained and made available to subsequent generation. As the concrete basis on which memory functions and operations are implemented, the carrier provides a natural basis for organizing existing approaches. Accordingly, we distinguish four major types of memory carriers:
blocks.zh: 我们使用记忆载体来表示保留历史信息并提供给下一代的表示对象. 作为执行记忆功能和运作的具体基础,承运人为安排现有做法提供了自然基础。 因此,我们区分了四种主要的记忆载体:

blocks.en: • Visual Memory (§ 3.1 ), which preserves past frames, clips, or observation-aligned visual representations as reusable historical evidence. • Implicit State Memory (§ ), which retains history in model-native latent states without predefined semantic or geometric structure. • Explicit State Memory (§ ), which represents history through structured variables describing entities, scene layouts, dynamics, relations, events, or other interpretable world states. • Adaptive Parametric Memory (§ ), which encodes sequence-, instance-, or experience-specific information in designated parameters or adaptable weights updated from prior evidence.
blocks.zh: • 视觉记忆(第3.1节),保留过去的帧、片段或与观测相配合的视觉表现,作为可重复使用的历史证据。 • 隐性国家记忆(§),它保留了模型内潜态的历史,没有预先定义的语义结构或几何结构。 · 明确的国家记忆(§),它通过结构化变量代表历史,描述实体,场景布局,动态,关系,事件,或其他可解释的世界状态. • 适应性参数内存(§),将序列、实例或经验特定信息编码在指定的参数中,或根据先前证据更新的适应性加权。

blocks.en: Visual Memory (§ 3.1 ), which preserves past frames, clips, or observation-aligned visual representations as reusable historical evidence.
blocks.zh: 视觉记忆(§ 3.1),它保存了过去的帧,剪辑,或观察-对齐的视觉表现作为可重复使用的历史证据.

blocks.en: Implicit State Memory (§ ), which retains history in model-native latent states without predefined semantic or geometric structure.
blocks.zh: 隐性状态记忆(§),它保留了在模型内潜态中的历史,没有预先定义的语义结构或几何结构.

blocks.en: Explicit State Memory (§ ), which represents history through structured variables describing entities, scene layouts, dynamics, relations, events, or other interpretable world states.
blocks.zh: 明确状态记忆(§),它通过描述实体,场景布局,动态,关系,事件或其他可解释的世界状态的结构化变量来代表历史.

blocks.en: Adaptive Parametric Memory (§ ), which encodes sequence-, instance-, or experience-specific information in designated parameters or adaptable weights updated from prior evidence.
blocks.zh: 适应性参数内存(§),将序列、实例或经验特定信息编码于指定的参数或从先前证据中更新的适应性加权。

This taxonomy is defined by the form of the memory-bearing object rather than by the preservation goal it serves. In practice, a single AR video generation system may combine visual anchors, latent caches, structured states, and adaptive parameters within the same generation pipeline.

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual Memory
blocks.zh: 3.1 视觉记忆

blocks.en: Definition. Visual memory preserves historical information as observation-aligned visual evidence, either as directly renderable content or as latent representations derived from specific past frames, clips, or regions.
blocks.zh: 定义。 视觉内存保存历史信息,作为与观测相联的视觉证据,或者作为直接可渲染的内容,或者作为来自特定过去帧,剪辑,或区域的潜在表现.

blocks.en: A visual memory unit may therefore be an RGB frame, a video clip, or a VAE latent, provided that it remains traceable to a specific historical observation or segment. The defining criterion is not whether a memory unit is directly human-readable, but whether it retains a traceable correspondence to the historical visual evidence from which it was derived.

blocks.en: Compared with more consolidated or structured state representations, visual memory retains high-fidelity appearance and spatial detail with relatively little abstraction. Its contents remain tied to identifiable historical observations, allowing past visual evidence to be reused when needed by subsequent generation. This fidelity, however, comes with two main costs. First, retaining observation-level evidence introduces substantial redundancy, so storage and computation can grow with rollout length unless memories are selectively retained or compressed. Second, because the stored evidence may itself be generated, visual artifacts or inconsistencies can be preserved and later reintroduced into subsequent generation.
blocks.zh: 相比于更集成或结构化的状态表现,视觉内存保留了高真实性外观和空间细节,相对较少抽象. 其内容仍与可识别的历史观测联系在一起,允许在后代需要时重新使用过去的视觉证据。 然而,这种忠诚有两个主要代价。 首先,保留观察级证据引入了大量冗余,因此,除非有选择地保留或压缩记忆,否则存储和计算可以随着延伸长度而增长. 第二,由于所储存的证据本身可能生成,视觉文物或不一致之处可以保存,后来被重新引入后一代.

blocks.en: We organize visual memory primarily by encoding space, distinguishing ➀ pixel-space visual memory from ➁ VAE-space visual memory . The former retains directly renderable RGB observations, whereas the latter stores observation-aligned latents in an autoencoder or generator latent space.
blocks.zh: 我们主要通过编码空间来组织视觉记忆,区分QQ像素-空间视觉记忆和QQVAE-空间视觉记忆. 前者保留了直接可转换的RGB观测数据,而后者则在自动编码器或生成器潜在空间中存储了对齐的观测潜在数据。

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Pixel-Space Visual Memory
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 像素-空间视觉记忆

A pixel-space memory unit may correspond to either an individual historical frame or a temporally contiguous clip: 𝐦 i pix = 𝐱 s i : u i = ( 𝐱 s i , 𝐱 s i + 1 , … , 𝐱 u i ) , s i ≤ u i , \mathbf{m}^{\mathrm{pix}}_{i}=\mathbf{x}_{s_{i}:u_{i}}=\left(\mathbf{x}_{s_{i}},\mathbf{x}_{s_{i}+1},\ldots,\mathbf{x}_{u_{i}}\right),\qquad s_{i}\leq u_{i}, (17) where s i = u i s_{i}=u_{i} corresponds to frame-level memory and s i < u i s_{i}<u_{i} to clip-level memory. Each unit remains directly traceable to a specific historical frame interval, making it the most directly inspectable form of visual memory. It can be rendered, replaced, or re-encoded into the generator’s native input representation when needed.

blocks.en:
Frame-level memory stores complete historical frames as its basic units: 𝐌 n frame = { 𝐦 i pix ∣ i ∈ ℐ n vis , s i = u i } . \mathbf{M}^{\mathrm{frame}}_{n}=\left\{\mathbf{m}^{\mathrm{pix}}_{i}\mid i\in\mathcal{I}^{\mathrm{vis}}_{n},\;s_{i}=u_{i}\right\}. (18) Individual frames preserve fine-grained appearance, identity cues, texture, viewpoint-specific structure, and other visual details that may be difficult to reconstruct after the corresponding observation leaves the local context.
Existing designs broadly follow three strategies. At the local end of this spectrum, recent-frame retention [ voleti2022mcvd , gao2024vid ] ( e.g. , MCVD) provides dense short-range conditioning for local continuity. Such history primarily belongs to the active context when it is supplied densely at every step; it assumes a memory role when selected or retained beyond default local access. Sparse anchor frames [ ren2024consisti2v , yang2026gloria , li2026everanimate , tian2026streamchar , qiu2026ge , lai2026groundshot ] ( e.g. , ConsistI2V) preserve stable long-range references; and retrieval-based approaches [ yu2025context , li2025vmem , li2026i3dm , guo2025end , zhu2026shareverse , li2026walking ] ( e.g. , Context-as-Memory) reactivate non-local frames according to visual or geometric relevance. These choices trade coverage and accessibility against storage and reuse errors: dense retention is redundant, while sparse or retrieved references may become stale, misaligned, or inconsistent with the current state. More fundamentally, a single frame records an observed state but provides limited evidence about the temporal process that produced it.

(19) The retained segment may correspond to a recent generated chunk [ yang2023video , gao2024ca2 , weng2024art , song2025history , xie2025progressive ] ( e.g. , LGC-VD, Ca2-VDM), an event-centered interval ( e.g. , LCT [ guo2025long ] ), or a retrieved historical episode ( e.g. , PlenopticDreamer [ fu2026plenoptic ] ). Relative to frame memory, clips preserve not only appearance and scene state but also short-range motion, temporal order, and interaction dynamics, providing stronger temporal evidence across AR generation boundaries. This additional information comes at higher storage and conditioning cost, and previously observed motion may become an outdated prior when the current action, scene state, or intended dynamics have changed.

blocks.en: Pixel-space memory trades efficiency for direct access to high-fidelity historical evidence. Frame memory is well suited to visual anchoring and state recall, whereas clip memory additionally preserves short-range temporal evolution at greater cost. In both cases, reliable reuse requires retaining evidence that remains relevant without repeatedly propagating stale or erroneous observations.
blocks.zh: 像素-空间内存交易效率直接访问高真实性历史证据. 帧内存非常适合视觉锚定和状态召回,而剪辑内存额外以更高的成本保存短程时间演化. 在这两种情况下,可靠的再利用都要求保留仍然具有相关性的证据,而不必反复传播陈旧或错误的观察。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 VAE-Space Visual Memory
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 VAE-空间视觉记忆

blocks.en: VAE-space visual memory retains historical observations in the latent space of a video VAE or a related visual autoencoder. Its key property is that the latent representation remains aligned with the source observation and can be approximately decoded back to visual space. For a historical segment 𝐱 s i : u i \mathbf{x}_{s_{i}:u_{i}} , where s i = u i s_{i}=u_{i} denotes a single frame and s i < u i s_{i}<u_{i} a video clip, its clean VAE-space representation is: 𝐦 i vae , 0 = E VAE ( 𝐱 s i : u i ) ∈ ℝ T i ′ × H ′ × W ′ × C ′ , D VAE ( 𝐦 i vae , 0 ) ≈ 𝐱 s i : u i , \mathbf{m}_{i}^{\mathrm{vae},0}=E_{\mathrm{VAE}}(\mathbf{x}_{s_{i}:u_{i}})\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{i}^{\prime}\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times C^{\prime}},\qquad D_{\mathrm{VAE}}(\mathbf{m}_{i}^{\mathrm{vae},0})\approx\mathbf{x}_{s_{i}:u_{i}}, (20) where E VAE E_{\mathrm{VAE}} and D VAE D_{\mathrm{VAE}} denote the VAE encoder and decoder, respectively, and T i ′ T_{i}^{\prime} , H ′ H^{\prime} , W ′ W^{\prime} , and C ′ C^{\prime} denote the temporal, spatial, and channel dimensions of the latent representation. In particular, T i ′ T_{i}^{\prime} depends on both the duration of the source segment and the temporal compression rate of the VAE. Although spatial and temporal compression may reduce resolution, the resulting latent remains tied to a bounded source interval: a temporal latent slice may correspond to a single frame under temporally uncompressed encoding or to a short group of adjacent frames under a temporally compressive video VAE. This observation alignment distinguishes VAE-space visual memory from generic hidden states whose contents need not correspond to identifiable past observations.

blocks.en: Existing systems realize VAE-space memory through several operational patterns. Sequential carry-over ( e.g. , LVDM [ he2022latent ] ) conditions a future chunk on preceding latent clips or prefixes. Windowed designs [ kim2024fifo , xie2025progressive , chen2025ouroboros , mao2026yume1 , yang2026decmem , huang2026learning , duan2026long ] ( e.g. , FIFO-Diffusion, PA-VDM) retain a bounded queue or overlapping set of historical latents, sometimes assigning different noise levels to different parts of the retained context. Retrieval-based designs [ hu2026longlive , guo2026memorize , akdemir2026zero , guo2026contextmaster ] ( e.g. , LongLive-RAG) instead preserve non-local latent blocks as separately accessible entries and reactivate them when distant visual evidence becomes relevant. These strategies differ in how memory is maintained and accessed, while sharing the same observation-aligned latent carrier.

blocks.en: Relative to decoded RGB history, VAE-space memory is more compact and more closely matched to the representation consumed by latent-space generators, reducing storage and conditioning overhead and, in some designs, avoiding repeated decoding and re-encoding. This efficiency comes at the cost of information loss and stronger model coupling: details removed by the encoder cannot be recovered from the stored latent, and representation changes across autoencoders or generator variants may limit reuse. Moreover, errors retained in generated latents can still be fed back into subsequent AR steps and accumulate over long rollouts. VAE-space memory therefore provides an efficient intermediate point between pixel-level fidelity and more strongly compressed or consolidated neural state.
blocks.zh: 相对于解码的RGB历史,VAE-space内存更为紧凑,更贴近潜在空间生成器所消耗的表达,减少了存储和调节管理费用,在一些设计中也避免了重复的解码和重新编码. 这种效率的代价是信息丢失和更强大的模型耦合:编码器去除的细节无法从存储的潜伏物中回收,跨自动编码器或生成器变体的表示变化可能会限制再利用. 此外,在生成的潜伏物中留下的错误仍然可以反馈到随后的AR步骤中,并在长期展开过程中积累。 因此,VAE-space内存提供了像素级忠诚度与更强压缩或巩固神经状态之间的高效中间点.
